reason: Restaurant dine-in module M1 for FOOD trial stores in local V3 print mode: one entry button on the Desktop cashier, table overview, open/order/add/void/settle/clear, kitchen notices through the existing Desktop print bridge, legacy checkout/cancel guards for dining bills. Additive schema: three enums, four tables, one nullable column on SaleRecord.
knownLimitations: The r4 limited independent review and native Prisma validation are complete; this record is not a substitute for the required independent L3 review record.

Native Prisma CLI validation passed on macOS Bash 3.2 with Prisma CLI 7.6.0 against a loopback-only disposable database: deploy, repeat deploy, migrate diff, drift/error/test-failure/SKIP negative cases, and 31 database tests (31 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped).

The historical migration chain cannot build an empty database (fails at 20260531000000_customer_order_campaign). This is the baseline's own state; it was recorded, not repaired, and no full empty-database chain is claimed.
No FIELD evidence: no real printer, no real Desktop shell, no trial store.

While the employee window shows the dine-in page the cashier page is unmounted, so nothing on that computer announces a new H5 customer order. A minimal plan exists (H5-REMINDER-PROPOSAL.md) and is NOT implemented; it needs a Founder decision.

No claim-existing-payment action in M1 (excluded by Founder). A dining bill that money was taken for outside the dine-in page (legacy checkout during an application rollback) cannot be voided, settled or extended from the dine-in page; its table stays occupied until a person resolves it. A rollback runbook must prevent this.

app/api/payments/[paymentId]/confirm and cancel are unchanged. Their reachability for a dining bill is analysed in LEGACY-PAYMENTS-REACHABILITY.md and awaits the reviewer's verification. A rollback runbook draft exists (docs/desktop/es-dine-in-01-rollback-runbook.md in this draft change set) and is not in force.

A kitchen notice is shown as sent only when the Desktop print core's own report has produced a print job row classified PRINTED. Between the page's submit and that report (normally a few seconds) and whenever the report never arrives, the notice is shown as unknown and stays in every needs-checking list. No FIELD measurement of that delay exists.

The recovery list and its entrance check have no time window; their query cost grows with a store's count of ended meals. No index was added (the schema is unchanged in r4) and no performance verification on production-sized data was done.
